blocks.label: My role at a glance
items: I led the member-first redesign of CareHub, end to end.
I shaped the AI summary prompts: what to show, for which trigger, with examples.
I turned workflow data and evaluation results into design priorities.

blocks.html: CareHub showed one workflow at a time, even when a member had several in progress. Clinicians searched across tabs to piece together the full picture.

items: workflows open per member, on average
click rate on the Interactions tab

blocks.label: One member, one morning: how the AI summary changed

panels.text: Her neck pain won’t let up.
panels.alt: Amelia’s message: the neck pain is a constant dull ache that makes it hard to concentrate on anything.
panels.title: Amelia writes in
panels.quote: Hi Darshan. The neck pain is this constant dull ache that never really goes away, and it makes it hard to concentrate on anything. My back feels tight and stiff, especially when I wake up in the morning or after sitting for a long time, like at work.

panels.text: Age, job and hometown first. Her need is buried.
panels.alt: The old AI summary for Amelia: age, job and hometown first; her pain only in the third sentence.
panels.title: Old summary

panels.text: Her need first, every point sourced.
panels.alt: The new summary card, headed ‘Needs help with sudden pain increase’, with sourced insights and open tasks below.
panels.title: New AI context

view.cap: The final member view, with Amelia’s message beside it.
view.alt: The final CareHub member view for Amelia: the AI summary ‘Needs help with sudden pain increase’ at the top, with sourced insights and open tasks, beside the conversation with her own message.
